display.purpose: Store name in the vitrine hero only.

body.purpose: Descriptions and body copy, all surfaces.

label.purpose: Form labels, filter chips, nav items.

shadows.name: card-rest
shadows.purpose: Default card elevation, always paired with a border.

shadows.name: modal-toast-lift
shadows.purpose: Product modal and success toast, still paired with a border.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action across admin and public surfaces.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #1c1813; color: #ffffff; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 10px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; transition: background 0.2s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2c2620; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c9922c; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action, cancel, or dismissive action.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #6b5d52; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 10px 20px; border: 1px solid #e8e2d8; border-radius: 8px; transition: color 0.2s ease-out, border-color 0.2s ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #1c1813; border-color: #d4cec5; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c9922c; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form field across admin forms.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #f4f1eb; border: 1px solid #e8e2d8; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 12px; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #1c1813; transition: box-shadow 0.2s ease-out, border-color 0.2s ease-out; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #c4b8ae; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(201,146,44,0.4); border-color: rgba(201,146,44,0.6); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Product Card
components.description: White gallery card resting on the linen canvas.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e8e2d8; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(28,24,19,0.05); padding: 16px; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: #1c1813; } .ds-card-price { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: #c9922c; margin-top: 4px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Category/attribute filter pill, active and inactive states.
components.css: .ds-chip { padding: 6px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid #e8e2d8; background: #ffffff; color: #6b5d52; transition: all 0.2s ease-out; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: #d4cec5; color: #1c1813; } .ds-chip-active { background: #1c1813; border-color: #1c1813; color: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(28,24,19,0.05); }

components.name: Admin Nav Item
components.description: Sidebar and bottom-nav item, active/inactive states.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: block; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #9c8e84; transition: color 0.2s ease-out, background 0.2s ease-out; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: #1c1813; background: #f4f1eb; } .ds-nav-item-active { background: rgba(201,146,44,0.1); color: #c9922c; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview: Vitrine3D exists so that anyone who makes or curates something worth a second look — a 3D-printed prop, a hand-forged ring, a canvas, a car, a listing — can hang it on their own wall without renting space in a crowded marketplace. The interface is that wall: warm linen behind the glass, a single gallery light (the artisan gold accent) picking out the price and the call to action, and nothing else competing for attention. Every screen, admin or public, behaves like a quiet gallery attendant: present, helpful, never in front of the work. This system explicitly rejects the cold SaaS dashboard (sterile gray chrome, dense enterprise tables as the default surface) and the generic marketplace grid (anonymous tiles that make every seller look interchangeable). Warmth here is structural — carried by the linen canvas, the serif display type, and the restraint of a single accent color — not applied as gradients or decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Warm linen canvas, never stark white or cold gray
One accent color (artisan gold) used sparingly and deliberately — prices, active states, featured marks
Serif display type reserved for store names and headlines; sans-serif for everything functional
Flat, quiet surfaces lifted only by soft borders and shadow-sm, never dramatic shadows or gradients
Identical restraint across admin and public storefront — one visual language, two audiences

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: Artisan gold appears in exactly one role per screen at a time — a price, an active state, or a featured mark — never as decoration or a background wash.

rules.name: The Warm-Never-Cold Rule
rules.body: Every neutral in this system carries a warm linen undertone. A pure gray or pure white anywhere in a surface is a bug, not a variant.

rules.name: The Two-Moment Rule
rules.body: Playfair Display is earned, not decorative — it appears only on the store name and the landing headline. Everywhere else is Inter.

rules.name: The Passe-Partout Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from a border plus a soft, tight shadow — never a wide, dramatic blur, and never a shadow without a border underneath it.

dos: Do keep the artisan gold accent to one role per screen — price, active state, or featured mark.
Do use the ink button (#1c1813) as the primary action color; gold is an accent, not an action surface.
Do pair every shadow with a border underneath it.
Do reserve Playfair Display for the store name and landing headline only.
Do keep every neutral warm-linen-tinted — canvas, card, borders, all of it.
Do make placeholder text hit 4.5:1 against its raised-linen background, not a lighter 'elegant' gray.
donts: Don't build a cold SaaS dashboard feel — no sterile gray chrome, no dense tables as the default surface, no enterprise-tool spacing.
Don't build a generic marketplace grid — no anonymous, interchangeable product tiles; every seller's vitrine should feel personal.
Don't use gradients, glassmorphism, or border-left/border-right colored stripes anywhere in the system.
Don't pair a 1px border with a wide, soft box-shadow (blur >= 16px) — pick the border-plus-tight-shadow language above, never a floating ghost card.
Don't round cards or sections past rounded-2xl (16px) — this system is elegant, not 'insanely rounded'.
Don't repurpose the WhatsApp green for generic success states, or the success-green for the WhatsApp CTA — they're different signals.
